spec_case: issue #818 (cyberdiner check() reports a schemeless expo_url as unreachable instead of crashing)
description: expo_url has no scheme at all (no "://") -- check_url's refusal must land inside check()'s own try, same as any other bad expo_url, reported as an ordinary preflight 'not ready' failure, identically in both engines, never a bare uncaught urllib exception.
